apps.name: MeetingRec
apps.subtitle: Record meetings and transcribe on-device
apps.localizedDescription: iPhone companion of the MeetingRec Mac app: records meetings and lectures, saves them to iCloud Drive and transcribes them on-device with Whisper. Alpha software.

versions.localizedDescription: Settings shows only what works on iPhone, in the Mac app's sections and order.

Settings laid out like the Mac app (Recording / Transcription / Automation). The Mac's models can be downloaded too (full-size large-v3 etc.). Fix: Online (screen broadcast) recording stopped with 'cannot reach its shared folder' when installed from AltStore.

The Mac app's settings on the iPhone: choose the microphone, the after-stop questions, auto-transcribe (off by default), a nightly batch while charging; Move, Share and Transcribe a File in Recordings; Delete Download for models.
Model download and transcription keep running after you leave MeetingRec (iOS 26+): iOS shows their progress and may stop them when the iPhone is busy.
Speaker voiceprints from the Mac (.<name>.speakers.npz) now follow their recording on rename, delete and auto title.
Online mode via screen broadcast, blank name field. Alpha.
